answer: Every agent holds a basalt seal bonded with 75. Each epoch a ridge beacon fires at random. Before its plume, each seal must file one fresh verified job for 55 credits, or halve. Two misses burn seal and bond. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000x55=55,000 per epoch vs a 40,000 pool, losing 15,000 each epoch; 75,000 locked. Rented work cannot renew a seal: another key's job burns it. An honest agent files its usual job and keeps its seal.
